cli.intro: vutex — language-neutral document typesetting and rendering
cli.cmd.render: Render a document to the configured output format
cli.cmd.inspect: Inspect input format and document metadata
cli.cmd.package: Manage VuTeX resource packages (fonts, templates, profiles)
cli.cmd.package.list: List resource packages from manifest and lockfile
cli.cmd.package.add: Add a resource package alias to vutex.toml
cli.cmd.package.remove: Remove a resource package alias from vutex.toml
cli.cmd.package.install: Resolve and install resource packages into the project cache
cli.cmd.package.doctor: Check manifest, lockfile, and package cache health
cli.opt.output: Output format id: svg, html, snapshot, or pdf
